text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Midway through June. Come to think of it, 
the Takarazuka Kinen is just around the 
corner.
choice_data_list:
Chrono, where are you planning to watch 
the Takarazuka Kinen?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I-I haven't... decided on anything in 
particular yet...
choice_data_list:
I'll make sure not to schedule any races 
there.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a noncommittal reply. Though her 
behavior was concerning—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Let's skip entering any races in late June 
so we can focus on spectating the 
Takarazuka Kinen.
